title.en:
That which is done
with love is well done.
title.zh:
以爱完成之事，
方为善成。

$comment: The sentence as van Gogh wrote it, in Dutch. Transcribed from the Van
Gogh Museum / Huygens ING edition of letter 143, sheet 1r:1, where it
closes 'Het is goed om zooveel lief te hebben als men kan...':
'en wat met liefde gedaan wordt dat wordt goed gedaan.' The leading
'en' and the full stop are dropped because the quotation starts mid-
sentence; not one other word, mark or spelling is changed — the
nineteenth-century 'wordt ... wordt' is his, not a typo.
It carries its own line breaks for the same reason `title` does, and
it is broken into the same number of lines as the translation, so the
two are set in the same shape. TWO lines each since 20 September 2026,
when the motto left the hero column for the band under the masthead:
four short lines were a column, and a column is the thing that band
exists to stop being.
original.text:
wat met liefde gedaan wordt
dat wordt goed gedaan

$comment: The motto, in van Gogh's own words: letter 143 to Theo, Amsterdam, 3 April
1878 — 'that which is done with love is well done' (vangoghletters.org/en/let143).
The Dutch original is set above the translation; see `original` above.
`title` holds its line breaks (\n). The motto is set as written, never
re-wrapped by the browser, so the attribution can align to its real right
edge; a browser cannot shrink a box to the longest line of wrapped text.
`attribution` is the full name. He signed the paintings 'Vincent'; the
name under a quotation is the man's, and his was Vincent Willem van Gogh.

about.$comment: Paragraphs from the original draft, plus one addition from finding D-04.
$portrait: THE ARTIST'S PORTRAIT, which About carries in both the places it appears:
beside the homepage section, and as the frontispiece of the page itself.
The photograph is not here. It goes in masters/portrait.jpg, like every
other photograph on the site, and npm run build:images cuts it. Until it
exists the frame holds a placeholder card, so the layout is real and can
be judged — and a RELEASE build leaves the frame out altogether rather
than ship an empty mat (readiness ID-08, the same arrangement WK-10 uses
alt is NEEDS-INPUT because nobody can describe a photograph that has not
been taken. Rule ID-07 requires it the moment the master exists, and owns
the path until then so the general placeholder backstop leaves it alone.

en: These paintings are my creations — born from moments, places, and feelings I wanted to hold onto long enough to paint. I also hope they can serve, in a small way, as a form of support: I personally donate 10% of my profits from this shop each quarter to research related to bipolar disorder.

The works on this site have accumulated slowly over the past few years. There aren't many — partly because I paint slowly, and partly because I don't want to make something simply for the sake of making it. More than trying to create something impressive, I want the work to feel honest. If you paused for a moment in front of a certain painting, perhaps that pause is enough. It may be saying what I hoped it would.

Every work here is photographed under controlled lighting against a colour reference, and the images are prepared in sRGB so they show as accurately as a screen allows. Even so, screens differ, and paint keeps changing after it leaves the studio. Van Gogh knew this about his own colours and thought it was a reason to be bolder, not more careful: “All the colours that the Impressionists have brought into fashion are unstable, so there is all the more reason not to be afraid to lay them on too crudely — time will tone them down only too much.”
zh: 这些画是我的创作——来自我想留住、久到足以画下来的瞬间、地方与感受。我也希望它们能以微小的方式成为一种支持：我每季度个人捐出本店利润的 10%，用于双相情感障碍相关研究。
这些作品是过去几年慢慢积累的。数量不多——一部分因为我画得慢，一部分因为我不想只为了做而做。比起做出令人惊艳的东西，我更希望作品是诚实的。如果你曾在某一幅画前停留片刻，也许那一刻就够了。它也许正在说我希望它说的话。
每件作品都在受控光线下、对照色卡拍摄，图像以 sRGB 处理，力求在屏幕上尽可能准确。即便如此，屏幕各不相同，而颜料在离开画室后仍在变化。梵高深知自己颜色的这一点，并认为这是更大胆而非更谨慎的理由：「印象派带起来的那些颜色都不稳定，所以更没有理由害怕把它们铺得太浓——时间只会把它们冲淡得太过分。」

en: Choose a piece and use the payment link, or message me with any questions first.
I'll confirm your shipping address by email and send a payment link if you don't have one.
The piece is packed flat between acid-free boards, or upright if it's on canvas, and shipped with a tracking number.
zh: 选择作品并使用付款链接，或先与我联系提出任何问题。
我会通过邮件确认您的收件地址，如尚未收到付款链接会一并发送。
作品以无酸卡纸夹平包装（布面作品则直立包装），寄出并提供追踪号。

accessNote.$comment: Finding B-06. Satisfies the CRD, the UK anticipatory duty, and the US alternative-access expectation - and lets a blind collector actually buy the painting.
accessNote.en: If any part of this site stops you buying a painting, email me. I'll describe the work to you, take your order, and arrange payment and shipping personally — usually within two working days.
accessNote.zh: 如果本网站的任何部分妨碍了您购买作品，请给我发邮件。我会为您描述作品、接受订单，并亲自安排付款与寄送——通常在两个工作日内。

$moreWorks: AW-09. A work page used to end on a rule and one right-aligned link to the
next work: no way back to the catalogue, nothing else by the same hand,
nothing from the same series. A leaf page that stops is a leaf page the
reader leaves. The heading is the series' own where there are siblings to
show, and the general one where the rest of the catalogue fills in.

enquireToBuy.$comment: Finding A-02. Used instead of ui.buy whenever a work has no checkoutUrl, so the label matches what the control actually does.

rights.zh: 所有作品版权归艺术家所有。

$shop: Whether this site can take a payment without an enquiry. It used to be
inferred — a cart route missing from placeholders.routes meant the cart had
been BUILT — and that inference broke the moment AW-07 took the cart control
out because there is no cart, rather than because there is one. The readiness
gate reads this instead: PY-02 asks for a transaction ceiling only once there
is something for it to cap.

$comment: Decision D1. The masthead shows search, account and cart, and each links to a
route that does not exist yet, so a click lands on the site's 404 page. The
controls are real links with real accessible names; only their destinations
are missing. check-links.mjs requires every link marked data-placeholder to be
listed here AND to be dead: when one of these pages is built, its entry must
come out of this list, or the build fails. README, 'Scripting still needed'.
EMPTY since AW-07. Three e-commerce icons in the most valuable strip on the
site, for a catalogue of six unique objects sold by enquiry, say 'store
template' — which is the wrong first signal for a one-artist gallery and the
wrong one for anyone judging the design. All three were blockers under SH-01
for the same underlying reason: a control that leads nowhere. The masthead is
now the wordmark, four words of navigation and the language switch, which is
the control on this site that actually changes something.
Nothing was deleted to get here. The bar is built from this object, so a
route put back puts its control back — icon, accessible name in both
languages, 44px target — and SH-01 asks for the page it points at, exactly
as before.
$social: The same arrangement for the footer's channel marks. A channel whose
handle in seller.artist is still NEEDS-INPUT has no address to link to,
so its mark points here — a route that does not exist — and the click
lands on the 404 page, which says in both languages what is still being
built. Supplying the handle turns the mark into the real profile link
and takes it out of this set by itself.
Kept separate from `routes` on purpose: those three are decision D1 and
are waived one by one for a release; these clear themselves when rule
ID-06 is satisfied, which a release build already requires.

$notFound: The 404, which is bilingual because nothing knows the visitor's language
before it is served. It used to name search, accounts and the cart as the
things still being built; AW-07 took those three controls out of the
masthead and emptied placeholders.routes, so the page was advertising
features nothing on the site links to. What still lands here is a mistyped
address, an old link, and the footer's channel marks whose handles are
owed — so it says what is true of all three and names nothing.

body.en: This page does not exist — or does not exist yet. Some of what this site will have is still being built.
body.zh: 此页面不存在，或尚未开放。本站的部分功能仍在建设中。

$comment: THE SERIES. Each is a room of the catalogue at /works/series/{id}/, a tab in the
Works navigation and a card on the homepage — all generated from this list.
A work belongs to exactly one series: its `section` field in artworks.json holds
the id. A NEW SERIES IS AN ENTRY HERE AND NOTHING ELSE: no template changes.
Genres (landscape, portrait, still life...) are NOT series: they cut across
series, so they are facets on the Works page, not rooms. See `genres` below.
The ids 'series' and 'sold' are reserved and may not be used as work slugs.

intro.en: Each piece is a unique physical object. Click through for full dimensions, a detail of the surface, and how it looks on a wall.

intro.en: Studies in tribute to the artists who shaped my eye. Not original compositions, and priced lower than original works.
intro.zh: 向塑造了我眼光的艺术家致敬的习作。非原创构图，定价低于原作。

epigraph.$comment: Moved here from the hero. This is the room it belongs in.

quote.en: I want to make drawings that move some people… Whether in figures or in landscapes, I would like to express not something sentimentally melancholic but deep sorrow.
quote.zh: 我想画出能打动人的画……无论是人物还是风景，我想表达的不是伤感的忧郁，而是深沉的悲恸。

$comment: Subject genres, for growth. Empty today. A work may list several in `genres`
(artworks.json). The Works page shows a genre filter only once at least two
genres are in use among available works — one genre is not a choice. Until
then this list is documentation of the vocabulary, and the build checks that
every genre a work names is declared here.

previewBlocked.zh: 预览版——尚未开放销售。网站上线前仍有 {n} 项关键信息待补充。

previewReady.en: Preview build. Every critical detail is supplied; the live site is the release build.
previewReady.zh: 预览版本。所有关键信息均已补齐；正式网站以发布版本为准。
